item.title: Hello World
item.description: Welcome to SighnWaive’s new blog. This site is built with Hugo and designed for the nighttime hacker who loves orange. What’s Here HTB Status - Current rank, points, and boxes pwned from Hack The Box GitHub Stats - Public repos, followers, and more Blog Posts - HTB writeups, CTF solutions, and hacking notes Flashbang Mode Click the FLASHBANG button in the nav to toggle to a high-contrast orange-on-white theme. Your preference is saved locally.
